text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr injured herself during
training,
so I've hurried her to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. A whirling wind swept my
legs out
from under me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I'd recoiled, however, the wind would
have
consumed me completely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's return to training. The winds that
blow back
after the storm blow with
even greater strength.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's return to training. The winds that
blow back
after the storm blow with
even greater strength.

Making your comeback comes after h...
If you're that set on it, let's do...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But this injury will take some time to
heal...
choice_data_list: Making your comeback comes after y...
Making your comeback comes after h...
If you're that set on it, let's do...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes, I wouldn't want to become
any more of
a burden, after all.
choice_data_list: That's why we should hold off on t...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll focus on recovering from my
injury for
now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And then... I'll blow back even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, a very disappointed Yamanin
Zephyr
decides to rest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you! I will whip up a wind of
greater
ferocity than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Yamanin Zephyr and I
return to
the track. However...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
U-urgh... But...
I have to ride the wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I misjudged my current
condition.
choice_data_list: Let's take today off to rest after...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Doing her best not to put any weight on
her
injury, Yamanin Zephyr falls into
dejection.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I may not be running like a gale... but I
feel good.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I know, I must be very careful. Please
don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking care not to strain her injury,
Yamanin
Zephyr continues training.
